title: Northern Star
description: Northern star is a small modpack for a server by the same name made by me and some of my friends. This official modpack includes all the required mods and some client side mods.
body:
# **NORTHERN STAR**

The Northern Star modpack is a semi-modern modpack with AMAZING and FUN mods that are included! It is not meant to be challenging or a specific type of difficulty, simply to add technology to your silly little minecraft world!

# WHAT MODS???
glad you asked!

we have things like...
- Simple Voice Chat
- Vivecraft
- ALL OF MACAWS STUFF
- Dimensional Doors
- CC: Tweaked
- Artifacts
- Vanilla Backport

_And even lesser known mods like,_
- Vista
- Wiretap
- Analog

# WHY THIS MODPACK???
i dunno man, its FUN! for FUNSIES! why not have FUN! and FUN! and FUN! FUN! FUN!

# PERFORMANCE???
Its pretty good :3

# KNOWN BUGS
If you turn a Vista television on with a hollow tape connected to a viewfinder while being in VR, you become sent up into the stratosphere (trust me its the best way to describe this) this is a mod that cannot be fixed on our side
If you turn on subtle effects, your HUD in VR mode will be BLACK completely.
